Jill was definetly my best team player tonight,  she got a ton of our closing tasks done the first hour of my shift and really set us up for success the rest of the night,  

I think Jen and Sofia are still struggling a bit with being on bar with another person.  this is something I coached both of them about,  their speed slows down SIGNIFICANTLY when I put them together on bar vs when I have them separated.  This is also regardless if it’s them together or them with another barista.  They seem to both get a little confused on what responsibilities are for milk/ shots (Sofia on shots putting milk in the drink/ Jen on milk trying to grab flavors). We had an open discussion about their feelings abt a 2 man bar and I answered a lot of their questions/ gave them advice on how to be more efficient on 2 man bars.  I think a lot of this concern from them also comes from the fact that they don’t work a lot of closes so they don’t get a lot of time on a 2 man bar.  Overall it was a very productive conversation!
